consent.title: Consent
consent.intro: You decide what the hospital can see. Changes apply to your next emergency.

consent.location.title: Location
consent.location.text: Shares your approximate position with the hospital so the ambulance can find you.
consent.history.title: Medical history
consent.history.text: Shares your conditions, allergies and medicines with the hospital that receives the alert.
consent.vitals.title: Live vitals
consent.vitals.text: Shares your heart rate, SpO2, blood pressure and glucose readings during an emergency.
consent.reports.title: Reports
consent.reports.text: Shares the reports you uploaded with the hospital that receives the alert.

passport.intro: Show this QR code to a responder or doctor. It opens a page with the details you chose to share. The code itself holds no health data.
passport.qrLabel: QR code for your health passport
passport.revokeConfirm: Stop this passport working? Anyone with the link will lose access.
passport.sharedNote: Only what your consent settings allow is shown.
passport.offlineNote: You are offline. The QR is shown from memory, but the link needs internet to open.
passport.createError: Could not create the passport. Please try again.
passport.revokeError: Could not revoke the passport. Please try again.
view.title: Health passport
view.preparedBy: Prepared by the patient. Not verified by a doctor.
view.notShared: The patient has not shared this section.
view.error: Could not load the passport. Check the internet connection.
view.gone: This passport is no longer available.
view.goneHelp: Ask the patient for a new QR code, or call 112 / 108.
notif.title: Notifications
notif.browser.title: HealthTwin (simulated)
notif.browser.label: Browser alerts
notif.browser.help: Show a pop-up when the app is in the background and the hospital or ambulance status changes. Off by default.
notif.browser.denied: Your browser blocked alerts. You can allow them in the browser settings.
notif.browser.unsupported: This browser does not support alerts.
why.title: Why this alert
why.unavailable: Reasons are not available right now
why.noneReported: You did not report any symptoms.
why.noneCheckIn: You did not report symptoms. This alert started from the safety check-in.
why.noReadings: No readings were shared. Live vitals sharing is off, or no reading was available.
why.neutral: This combination is on our alert checklist.
why.noMatch: Nothing matched our checklist. This does not say anything about your health.
why.draft: This checklist is a draft waiting for a doctor to review. It does not say what is wrong with you. If you feel unwell, call 112 / 108.

twin.altBp: Blood pressure over the last minute: top number between {{smin}} and {{smax}}, bottom number between {{dmin}} and {{dmax}}, usual range {{usual}}.
checkin.title: Are you OK?
checkin.countdown: Alert starts in {{count}} seconds if you do not answer
checkin.soundOn: Sound and vibration: on (tap to mute)
checkin.soundOff: Sound and vibration: off (tap to turn on)
checkin.note: Simulated safety check-in. If you do not answer, the app starts an alert like the emergency button does. Call 112 / 108 any time.
checkinSetting.title: Safety check-in
checkinSetting.help: If you turn this on and do not touch your phone for a while, the app asks "Are you OK?". If you do not answer in 30 seconds, it starts an alert.
checkinSetting.limits: This works only while the app is open on your screen. It cannot detect a fall by itself and cannot run when the app is closed.
checkinSetting.failed: Could not save. The setting was put back.
emergency.fromCheckIn: Started because you did not answer the safety check-in (simulated)
emergency.backOnlineSent: Back online. Your alert was sent.
emergency.viewSummary: See the record of this alert
sms.title: No internet. Tell your contacts by SMS
sms.help: Your phone will open its messages app with the text ready. You must press send yourself.
sms.textLabel: The text that will be used:
sms.body: I need help. This is a simulated alert from the HealthTwin demo.
sms.cannotKnow: The app cannot tell whether an SMS was sent. Call 112 / 108 if you need help now.
reminders.title: Medicine reminders
reminders.openOnly: Reminders only work while this app is open. Do not rely on them for medicines you cannot miss.
reminders.missed: Missed a dose? Ask your doctor or pharmacist what to do.
reminders.name: Medicine name
reminders.doseNote: Dose note (as written by your doctor)
reminders.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
reminders.maxReached: You can have at most {{count}} reminders.
reminders.notifyBody: Open the app to see it.
reminders.err.name: Enter the medicine name.
reminders.err.times: Add at least one valid time.
summary.title: Alert record
summary.record: This is a record of what the app did. It does not describe your health.
summary.docTitle: HealthTwin AI: record of an alert (simulated)
summary.readingsTitle: Readings at the time of the alert

summary.footer: Prepared by the app. Not verified by a doctor.

summary.shareFailed: Could not share. Use Copy or Download instead.
summary.shareNote: You choose where this goes. The app does not upload or send it.
past.title: Past alerts
demo.speedHelp: Applies to alerts started after you change it.
demo.pinTitle: Pin a value (leave empty for automatic)
demo.simHelp: These switches only change the app's behaviour. They never touch your real network. Reset turns them off.
rehearsal.title: Rehearsal script
rehearsal.reset: Press Reset demo, then sign in
rehearsal.home: Home: live vitals, trend and usual range
rehearsal.language: Switch to Hindi, then Gujarati, then English
rehearsal.profile: Choose the Heart emergency profile and watch the trend change
rehearsal.contacts: Point out the contacts notified and Time since alert
rehearsal.summary: Open the alert record and show Share
rehearsal.passport: Create the passport QR and open the responder page
rehearsal.offline: Turn on No data connection and show the SMS card
rehearsal.fall: Press Simulated fall and let the check-in time out
screen.needsConnection: This screen needs an internet connection the first time you open it. Go back, or call 112 / 108 if you need help now.
invite.title: Invite a family member
invite.help: Create a code and give it to a relative. They sign in to this app with their own account and enter it. They only see what you chose to share.
invite.error: Could not create a code. Please try again.
